title: An induction study to investigate the efficacy and safety of duvakitug in participants with moderately to severely active Ulcerative Colitis
official: A multicenter, multinational, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3, induction study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of duvakitug in participants with moderately to severely active Ulcerative Colitis.
summary: Main objective: To assess the efficacy of duvakitug as induction therapy in the treatment of moderately to severely active UC compared to placebo.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants aged ≥18 and ≤80 years of age at Screening. Where permitted locally, participants 16 to <18 years of age who meet the definition of Tanner Stage 5 for development
2. Confirmed diagnosis of moderately to severely active UC for at least 3 months prior to Baseline
3. Demonstrated inadequate response, have shown loss of response or intolerance to conventional therapies or advanced therapies
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants with Crohn’s Disease (CD), indeterminate colitis
2. Current diagnosis of Ulcerative Proctitis
3. Participants with surgical bowel resection within the past 3 months prior to Baseline, or a history of >3 bowel resections
4. Prior or current high-grade gastrointestinal (GI) dysplasia
5. Participants on treatment with but not on stable doses of conventional therapies prior to baseline
6. Participants with prohibited medications or therapies prior to baseline
7. Participants with previous exposure to anti-TL1A investigational therapy
